verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches on this story. Docs show profiles can be suppressed by sending a 'Suppress Person' event via the Pipelines API, and workspaces include an 'Unsubscribed' segment, which implies unsubscribe status is tracked. Nothing shows bounces or spam complaints being suppressed automatically, or suppression being honored across broadcasts, transactional messages and push. Missing for 10: documented automatic bounce/complaint suppression, unsubscribe enforcement across every send type (including transactional), CAN-SPAM/GDPR default handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
